## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint issues comments — Browse subcommands.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint issues comments COMMAND [ARGS] [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Choose a subcommand, then inspect its exact --help before execution.

SUBCOMMANDS
  add                 add issue comments
  delete              delete issue comments
  get                 get issue comments
  list                Read issue children
  reply               Reply in the same authorized issue thread. Visibility internal|synced is fixed at creation; mentionMemberIds are exact authorized IDs.
  update              update issue comments

EXAMPLES
  sprint issues comments get --help

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).
```
